subject.title: Feature Request: TUI Notification When Agent Completes (Sound/Desktop Alert)

question: Should OpenClaw core add a default-off TUI completion notification contract, and if so which modes and platform backends should it support?
rationale: This request adds new local TUI behavior and proposed config keys rather than fixing a broken existing contract, so automation cannot safely choose desktop notifications, terminal bell, sound selection, defaults, and security boundaries.

options.title: Design a narrow TUI notifier
options.body: Keep this issue open and define opt-in modes, config schema, platform scope, and validation before implementation.

options.title: Fold into activity alerts
options.body: Treat this as a local-TUI subset of broader session activity/watchdog alerting and wait for that product direction to settle.

options.title: Decline core notifications
options.body: Close or redirect if maintainers want completion alerts handled by terminal settings, scripts, plugins, or companion apps rather than core TUI config.

recommendation.title: Design a narrow TUI notifier
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and define opt-in modes, config schema, platform scope, and validation before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current-history signal across the central TUI status and finalization paths.
